Chapter 6555: Waiting For The Right Time

Chapter 6555: Waiting For The Right Time

“I can give you a chance to try and I’ll forgive you.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Forget it, we had a chance of killing you back then with him involved. I’m not stupid now, you didn’t leave when you should have, clearly attempting to provoke us. Given the current circumstances, I don’t even think he can kill you.” The skull said: “The two old geezers don’t know that you’re feigning weakness and that a shift is enough to try. If they somehow think it through, they’ll be knocking on your door and begging for forgiveness.”

The skull seemed quite happy while thinking about the last scenario.

“Confidence isn’t a bad thing to have.” Li Qiye said.

“You were just missing a good excuse to kill all of us. Now, some fools are dumb enough to give you one.” The skull said.

“Don’t think of me as such a crafty person.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Enough bullshit. When you visited Three Immortals before, you clearly wanted to kill us if we didn’t cooperate with the three immortals’ help, all six of us.” The skull said.

“Maybe that’s something you would do.” Li Qiye shook his head: “Didn’t you guys live well after my departure? It was your internal conflict causing this mess, not me.”

“Haha, because Big Eye’s group agreed to help you.” The skull sneered: “If we didn’t comply and help your camp, you would have wiped us out and taken our things.”

“No need to theorize on things that didn’t happen.” Li Qiye waved dismissively.

“Fine, what are we going to do with this thing? What’s your treacherous plan?” The skull changed the topic while looking at the liquid.

“You do know that I am a being capable of killing immortals and fighting against the heaven. Your comments thus far are contemptuously offensive.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“I’m not looking down on you but it’s well known that you’ve always been a bastard.” The skull sneered: “You have a sadistic tendency of making others jump into the pit like a dog that can’t stop eating shit.”

“Sigh, at the very least, I’m carrying out my end of the bargain with Big Eye’s group. Is it outrageous for me to do a little something to help some friends out? I would do the same for you too.” Li Qiye lamented.

“True, true.” The skull’s eye sockets gleamed as he nodded repeatedly: “You are too kind.”

“I like helping people succeed the most, that’s why if someone wants this or that, I will definitely accommodate them. Ultimately, everyone will have their wishes, such a beautiful outcome.” Li Qiye smiled brightly.

“What do you want?” The skull knew Li Qiye was up to no good again.

“Someone lost an item and it got dirty. Now, I’ll clean it up and return it to someone else.” Li Qiye smiled and raised his hand, sealing the whole palace. Next, he prepared a portal next to the liquid.

“As I’ve said, a dog can’t stop eating shit.” The skull said.

“I’m an immortal, a true immortal who will fulfill everyone’s wishes.” Li Qiye corrected him.

“Please.” The skull responded with disdain.

***

A person hid in an unknown location in Heaven World, protected by layers of seals. He waited for the right opportunity, not just burying himself in hiding.

He thought this moment would never come but circumstances changed for the better. He couldn’t help but admire Xian Chengtian; he killed “Bao Pu” using a borrowed knife.

However, why did the guy go crazy and reveal so many secrets? Alas, none of this mattered because this was his time after Bao Pu’s death.

He had removed the Primal Devil Art and imprinted it onto someone else while keeping the borrowed power to himself. When the time was ripe, he could have taken it openly and justifiably. But unexpectedly, his lair was suddenly taken over. This was something they could have foreseen or more accurately, something he should have foreseen. After all, it was he who had dismantled the Primal Devil Art and transferred it onto someone else, while secretly keeping the power for himself.

What he hadn't anticipated was how quickly it would all unfold. He had thought that even if someone came for him, it would still take a long time. Yet, he was found—just like that, all of a sudden.

What was even stranger was that after they left, the other party stuck around and just like that, a new “Bao Pu” was born. He still had no idea why.

He guessed it could have been an attempt to wipe the rest out in one swoop but they never showed up.

He lost confidence and hope after losing his lair. However, Desolate Ancestor appeared and exposed it once more. It felt as if the heaven was aiding him.

He thought about this method before but he and Bao Pu were wary of Desolate Ancestor. Zhan Sansheng and the two redemption grounds wouldn’t do anything to Bao Pu but Desolate Ancestor was a different issue. Once the truth was revealed, she would definitely hunt Bao Pu down.

If Bao Pu couldn’t escape, then he would be dragged into it as well. This was the reason why they had stayed hidden all this time.

But now, “Bao Pu” was dead and Desolate Ancestor finished her mission. Corpse Wasteland was in disarray but the thing remained.

Recently, he felt desires again for the first time after severing them.

“Finally refined.” He prepared a formation for a supreme summoning technique.

As long as the desires were still there, he could fuse with them again and become the strongest beneath the immortal stage. The next ascension would only be a matter of time.

He tried numerous summons and sure enough, they became increasingly palpable.

“Return to me!” He shouted, no longer worrying about being exposed.

A smart rabbit has three burrows. Once he took back the refined desires, he would switch to another spot. This was a fair exchange.

“Boom!” Everyone heard an explosion and something soared out of Corpse Wasteland.

It looked like a meteor but instead of falling, it soared through the air toward an awaited portal. It entered the portal and was transported to the unknown cultivator’s hiding location.

“The source of desires!” He was ecstatic to see it and embedded it into his neckbone.

“Zzz...” The two began to fuse.
